Products.heroSub: Comprehensive plumbing solutions meeting the needs of infrastructure, residential, and industrial projects with the highest quality standards.
Products.pprDesc: Superior heat and pressure resistance, ideal for residential and industrial potable water installations. Manufactured with advanced technologies to ensure a lifespan exceeding 50 years.
Products.pvcDesc: Comprehensive piping solutions for potable water distribution, drainage, and irrigation networks. Exceptionally durable, chemical resistant, and easy to install.
Products.cpvcDesc: Engineered chlorinated polyvinyl chloride systems designed for high temperature and chemical resistance, ideal for industrial processing and hot/cold water supply.
Products.elecDesc: Heavy-duty insulating conduit systems for electrical cable protection with UV resistance, flame retardancy, and high mechanical impact strength.
Products.certsSub: All pipe and fitting product lines are officially certified under SABER and fully compliant with SASO technical regulations.

About.heroSub: Green Therm Future is a leading Saudi manufacturer in the plumbing systems industry, specializing in PP-R, UPVC, and CPVC pipes and fittings.
About.visionText: To be the preferred choice for sanitary solutions in Saudi Arabia and the region, by focusing on quality, innovation, and adopting advanced manufacturing technologies.
About.missionText: To provide high-quality products that support infrastructure projects and promote sustainability, with a strict commitment to international standards for durable and reliable products.
About.expertiseText: At Green Therm Future, we rely on accumulated technical and managerial expertise in the plumbing systems industry. We employ advanced production technologies and adhere to international quality standards to cover the requirements of major infrastructure projects, as well as the residential and industrial sectors.
About.factorySub: State-of-the-art automated extrusion lines and dedicated batch testing to SASO and international standards.
About.productionLineDesc: High-precision automated extrusion lines ensuring precise outer diameters and uniform wall thickness for high-pressure systems.
About.sabicCalloutText: We formulate exclusively with certified virgin polymer grades from SABIC, with zero regrind or recycled content. This provides maximum long-term hydrostatic strength and absolute safety for drinking water networks.
About.qualityLabText: Around-the-clock dimensional control, thermal expansion monitoring, and hydrostatic burst pressure testing to guarantee full SABER certificate compliance.
About.warehouseText: Expansive central warehousing strategically located in Malham, Riyadh, maintaining deep finished-goods inventory for immediate fulfillment across major infrastructure and construction projects.
About.certsSub: We adhere to the highest standards of quality and safety. All products are officially registered under SASO SABER and international ISO management systems.
About.warrantyDesc: Comprehensive warranty on all pipes and fittings

Sectors.heroSub: We are proud to be a trusted partner in infrastructure projects, providing specialized solutions that meet the requirements of various sectors.

Sectors.indDesc: Heavy-duty plumbing and piping solutions for factories and industrial facilities, featuring high resistance to heat and pressure.
Sectors.resDesc: Reliable and safe systems for residential complexes, commercial towers, and hospitals, ensuring peace of mind for decades.

Contact.heroSub: Our team is ready to answer your inquiries and provide the necessary technical support for your projects.
Contact.mgmtText: At Green Therm Future, we believe that true partnership begins with a deep understanding of our clients' needs. We don't just sell pipes; we deliver peace of mind through products we put our name on and guarantee for 50 years. Our doors are always open to partners in success.
